plan.name: acme-bug-triage-needs-info
plan.title: Triage unassigned bug issues
plan.description: Every weekday at 9am, find open unassigned bug issues in acme/api, ask for reproduction details and version, and label them needs-info.
plan.summary: Sweep open unassigned bug issues in the repo, comment with a standard info request, and mark them needs-info.
plan.generalization: The recording shows a repeated GitHub triage pattern. Generalize it into a gh-based sweep that finds every open issue in the repo labeled bug with no assignee, skips issues already marked needs-info, posts the standard clarification comment, and applies the needs-info label so the triage queue stays current.

values.name: Triage comment
values.value: Thanks for the report! Could you share exact reproduction steps and the version you're on?

steps.label: Find matching issues
steps.prompt: Use gh issue list -R {{repo}} --state open --label {{bug_label}} --assignee none to list every open issue with no assignee, then keep only the ones that do not already have the {{needs_info_label}} label. Collect the full set of matching issue numbers before making any changes.

steps.label: Request reproduction details
steps.prompt: For each matching issue, post the standardized comment {{triage_comment}} with gh issue comment -R {{repo}} <issue-number>. Keep the action explicit and process every issue in the collected set.

steps.label: Mark as needs-info
steps.prompt: For each matching issue that was commented on, add the {{needs_info_label}} label with gh issue edit -R {{repo}} <issue-number> --add-label {{needs_info_label}} so the triage state is visible in GitHub.

plan.summary: Weekday GitHub PR reminder for stale review requests.
plan.generalization: Generalize the one recorded PR into a repeatable GitHub review sweep: use `gh pr list`, `gh pr view`, and `gh pr comment` instead of the browser, evaluate every open PR that still needs review, compute the age cutoff at runtime, and post one gentle reminder comment per eligible PR while avoiding duplicate nudges.

values.name: Reminder comment prefix
values.value: Friendly ping — this PR has been waiting on review for more than two days.

steps.label: Find stale review PRs
steps.prompt: Use `gh pr list -R {{repo}} --state open --search 'review:required sort:created-asc'` to list all open pull requests that still need review. Compute the cutoff date at runtime as today minus {{age_days}} days, and keep only PRs created before that cutoff.

steps.label: Skip already-nudged PRs
steps.prompt: For each candidate PR, use `gh pr view -R {{repo}} <number> --json requestedReviewers,comments` to inspect its requested reviewers and existing comments. Skip any PR that already contains {{reminder_body_prefix}} so the automation does not post duplicate reminders.

steps.label: Post reminder comments
steps.prompt: For each remaining PR, use `gh pr comment -R {{repo}} <number> --body '...` to post a gentle reminder in {{repo}}. Include {{reminder_body_prefix}} and, when available, @-mention the requested reviewer(s) in the same comment.

values.name: Number of top articles to read

steps.label: Search for articles on the topic

plan.summary: This automation reads charges from your American Express activity page, locates and verifies the matching receipt PDFs, enters each reconciled charge into Expensify, and submits the expense report.
plan.generalization: The recording processed three specific charges by copying each one, checking its receipt PDF, and filing it in Expensify. The automation generalizes this to handle ALL charges in the current statement: it reads the entire activity list, locates receipt PDFs matching each charge by amount and date, verifies them, and files each one before submitting the report.

steps.label: Fetch recent card charges

plan.name: release-milestone-deployment
plan.title: Release milestone deployment
plan.description: Compile release notes from merged PRs for a milestone, bump the version, update CHANGELOG, deploy to production, and health-check the result. Runs on demand before each release.
plan.summary: When triggered, this automation fetches all merged PRs for a specified milestone using the gh CLI, extracts their titles, appends them to CHANGELOG.md, bumps the version with npm, commits and pushes the changes, runs the production deployment script, and verifies the deployment with a health check.
plan.generalization: A single release deployment requires gathering all merged PRs in a milestone (not just the three in this recording), adding their titles to the CHANGELOG, versioning, and deploying. The automation iterates over every merged PR for the target milestone, collects their summaries, and runs the complete release workflow end-to-end on a user-triggered schedule.

steps.label: Pull the latest main branch
steps.prompt: Use git to check out and pull the latest commits from the main branch (git checkout main && git pull).

steps.label: Gather merged PRs for the milestone
steps.prompt: Use gh pr list to fetch all merged PRs for milestone {{milestone}} in repo {{repo}} using: gh pr list -R {{repo}} --state merged --search 'milestone:{{milestone}}' --json 'number,title'. Extract all PR titles from the output.

steps.label: Update CHANGELOG with PR titles
steps.prompt: Read the current {{changelog_file}} file, append all the PR titles from the previous step (formatted as '- #<number> <title>'), and save the file.

steps.label: Bump version and commit
steps.prompt: Run npm version minor to bump the package version, then commit and push the changes (the npm version command will auto-commit).

steps.label: Deploy to production
steps.prompt: Run the production deployment script (./deploy.sh production) to deploy the release to the production environment.

steps.label: Health-check the deployment
steps.prompt: Use curl to verify the deployment by calling the health check endpoint (curl -s {{health_endpoint}}) and confirm it returns a 200 status.

plan.name: deploy-webapp-to-azure
plan.title: Deploy web app to Azure and record live URL
plan.description: Deploys a Node.js web app to Azure using the Azure CLI, verifies the site is live by fetching its health endpoint, and records the deployment timestamp and live URL in a tracking spreadsheet.
plan.summary: This automation deploys a specified Azure web app using the `az webapp up` CLI command, confirms the deployment succeeded by checking the live site, and appends a new row to the Deployments.xlsx spreadsheet with the timestamp and live URL for audit tracking.
plan.generalization: The recording deployed one specific app (contoso-crm) to a fixed resource group (web-prod). The automation generalizes this by accepting the app name, resource group, and runtime as fixed values, and discovering the deployed URL dynamically by constructing the standard Azure URL pattern and verifying it's live with a health check. The spreadsheet is always the same local file, so its path is fixed. The deployment timestamp is generated at run time.

steps.label: Sign in to Azure and deploy the app
steps.prompt: Use the Azure CLI (az command) with `az login` to ensure you are authenticated, then run `az webapp up --name {{app_name}} --resource-group {{resource_group}} --runtime {{runtime}}` to deploy the web app. Capture the deployment output to confirm success.

steps.label: Verify the live site is responding
steps.prompt: Construct the deployed site URL using the pattern https://{{app_name}}.azurewebsites.net/ and use web_fetch to fetch it and confirm it returns a successful response (HTTP 2xx status), verifying the deployment is live.

steps.label: Record deployment in the tracking spreadsheet
steps.prompt: Open the local file {{deployments_file}} using the xlsx skill. Add a new row with the current date/time (ISO format), the app name {{app_name}}, and the live URL https://{{app_name}}.azurewebsites.net/. Save the file.
